title: Zesty Middle Eastern Chickpea Grill
description: A fresh, gooey chickpea dish grilled to perfection with dill pickles and zesty spices, perfect for meal prep and served on a tagliere.
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a bowl, combine chickpeas, chopped dill pickles, olive oil, sumac, cumin, smoked paprika, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and pepper; mix well to coat.
Let the mixture marinate for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Preheat a grill pan or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat and brush lightly with oil.
Spread the chickpea mixture in an even layer on the griddle, creating a thin, round patty.
Grill for 6 minutes on one side until golden and slightly crispy, then flip and cook for another 4 minutes.
Remove the chickpea patty and transfer it onto a clean tagliere.
Top with fresh parsley and a handful of baby spinach, then serve immediately.
